limits: No obstruction to nonhomogeneous S0/R1 operations or arbitrary multi-port surgery.
reviewed_claims: For unordered nonempty directed k-path covers, k!*p_k(T)>=H(T)*binom(n-1,k-1).
The maximal-run formula is H(Q[T])=sum_k k!*W_k(Q,q)*p_k(T), where W_k counts quotient words with indistinguishable separated q occurrences.
A cyclic port has W_1=H(Q)>=3 and W_2>=1, by triangle-path extension and transitive-twin insertion.
Cyclic homogeneous one-port substitution satisfies H(Q[T])>=(n+2)*H(T), with an extra1 for even n, even when the context varies with T.
A singleton-SCC port gives exactly H(Q-q)*H(T); bounded multipliers through cyclic homogeneous ports cannot persist at unbounded source order.
